characters.continuity: Devil May Cry 3 / Devil May Cry 5
characters.summary: Devil Trigger Dante unlocks his inner demonic power, granting enhanced speed, health regeneration, and demonic aerial flight capabilities while wielding his legendary weapons.
weaknesses: Devil Trigger gauge is finite and depletes over time
limitations: Limited duration based on the Devil Trigger gauge
characters.formDifferences: Unlocks a demonic form that drastically boosts physical strength, speed, durability, adds passive regeneration, and grants flight.

sources.supports: Devil Trigger abilities, health regeneration, and flight capabilities

feats.claim: Transformed into Devil Trigger to overpower Vergil in their final clash

notableResults.note: Achieved after unlocking full Devil Trigger power.

campaignTags.claim: Dante sprouts demonic wings allowing him to fly in Devil Trigger form
Devil Trigger grants rapid health regeneration during combat

unknowns: Exact structural limitations of Devil Trigger durability across different game engines

characters.summary: Sin Devil Trigger Dante represents his ultimate demonic evolution, unleashing cataclysmic dark energy blasts, instantaneous flight, and overwhelming melee devastation.
weaknesses: Requires building up extreme demonic energy to activate
limitations: Drains rapidly and cannot be maintained indefinitely without sufficient demonic power
characters.formDifferences: Massive evolution beyond standard Devil Trigger, granting supreme power, altered appearance, and devastating ultimate attacks.

sources.supports: Sin Devil Trigger transformation abilities and stats

feats.claim: Defeated Urizen effortlessly upon first awakening Sin Devil Trigger

notableResults.note: Urizen was overwhelmed by the newly unlocked Sin Devil Trigger.

conditional.ability: Cataclysmic energy attacks and extreme stat boost
conditional.dependsOn: Awakening the Sin Devil Trigger using the Rebellion and Sparda swords

campaignTags.claim: Sin Devil Trigger grants true flight and aerial agility
Rapidly regenerates vitality while in Sin Devil Trigger

unknowns: The absolute ceiling of Sin Devil Trigger's destructive capacity

limitations: Rocketbarrel can malfunction or crash if overused

notableResults.citation: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest
notableResults.note: Fought alongside Dixie Kong to defeat King K. Rool.

campaignTags.claim: Uses the Rocketbarrel backpack for flight and recovery
Employs Peanut Popguns and Rocketbarrel gear in combat

unknowns: Exact payload capacity of his peanut popguns
